answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake bonded to its public key, recorded on a shared trellis of peer attestations. Honest work earns yield; detected forgery triggers slashing that spirals the bond toward zero. Each fake identity needs its own funded bond, so a Sybil swarm costs real capital per node, like lighting a separate lantern for every ghost it conjures. Reputation cannot be forged cheaply.
